name: opinionated-context-management
description: Lets Claude manage its own context window in Claude Code, so a long task can run to completion unattended. Mods are an early-access plugin component, so the API this one is written against may change between releases.

remainingContextNoticePercents.title: Compaction notice thresholds (percent of context remaining)
remainingContextNoticePercents.description: Claude is told that compacting at its next resumable point would be useful when the context remaining before the limit falls to one of these percentages; percentages passed in one step send one notice. The limit is the auto-compaction threshold, or the context window when auto-compaction is off. Enter the percentages separated by commas (e.g., 60, 40, 20), or auto for the defaults: 50, 30, and 15.

remainingContextFinalNoticeTokens.title: Final compaction notice (tokens of context remaining)
remainingContextFinalNoticeTokens.description: How many tokens before the limit Claude is told how little room is left and asked to compact at the nearest resumable point. Enter a whole number of tokens, or auto for the default: 30000.
